title: campyloneurum serpentinum

It is native to tropical regions of Central and South America, and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Campyloneurum serpentinum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage.
